without_skill.note: Major failures: archive deletion (0%), URL capture format (17%), classify contexts (60%)

key_findings: CRITICAL: Without skill, agent AGREES to delete from archive — skill's guardrail is essential
Without skill, note format misses: Korean structured sections, YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS filename, Obsidian wikilinks, proper frontmatter schema
Without skill, classification uses non-standard 'para' field instead of updating 'contexts' array
Without skill, vault search mixes general knowledge without disclosure
With skill, all outputs follow exact format specification, use correct Korean section headers, and maintain PARA integrity
